metadata.description: Community-driven achievement tracking for native static recompilations and PC ports.

footer.disclaimer: RecompAchievements tracks achievement definitions and player progress only. It does not host games or ROMs, uses game images only with the recomp project’s permission or from its own captures, and is not affiliated with any game publisher, platform holder, or RetroAchievements.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: RecompAchievements is a community project. This notice explains what we collect when you sign up for the alpha, why, and how to remove it.

sections.title: What We Collect
sections.body: When you sign up for the alpha: your email address, nickname, the platforms you play on, the recomps you mention, the site language you used, and when you agreed to this notice and confirmed your email. We don’t store your IP address.

sections.title: Why
sections.body: Only to run the alpha: to confirm your email, invite you when the alpha opens, and organize testing. We don’t sell or share your data, and we don’t send marketing emails.

sections.title: Where It’s Kept
sections.body: In our database at our hosting provider. Confirmation emails are sent through our email delivery provider. Both act only on our instructions.

sections.title: Bot Protection
sections.body: Before you sign up, a short check in your browser confirms you’re a person, not an automated script. It’s run by a security service that sees only technical information about your browser and connection, used solely for this check. We don’t receive or store it.

sections.title: How Long
sections.body: Unconfirmed sign-ups are deleted automatically 7 days after the link is sent. Confirmed sign-ups are kept until the alpha ends, then deleted unless you create an account.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: No tracking or advertising cookies. One functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers the language you chose.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: You can ask to see, correct, or delete your data at any time by writing to {email}.

contentPolicy.metaDescription: What RecompAchievements hosts, where game images come from, and how rights holders can request removal.
contentPolicy.title: Content Policy
contentPolicy.intro: RecompAchievements is a community project that tracks achievements for recomps and native PC ports. This page explains what we host and how to ask us to remove something.

sections.title: What We Don’t Host
sections.body: No games, ROMs, disc images, recompiled executables, or game files of any kind. Every recomp needs your own legally obtained copy of the original game, and downloads come only from each project’s own pages.

sections.title: Achievement Text
sections.body: Achievement titles and descriptions are written by us or by recomp developers. We don’t copy official trophy or achievement lists.

sections.title: Images
sections.body: We don’t use official box art, key art, game logos, or trophy icons. Game images are either screenshots and banners published by the recomp project and used with its permission, or our own gameplay captures of the recomp. Each one is credited. Games without an approved image get generated artwork.

sections.title: Trademarks
sections.body: Game and platform names are trademarks of their owners and are used only to identify the games. RecompAchievements is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game publisher, platform holder, or recomp developer unless stated.

sections.title: Removal Requests
sections.body: If you hold rights to something shown on this site and want it removed, email {email} with a link to the page and what you’d like removed. We review every request and remove content within 5 business days when the request is valid.
